summary.text: Teresa Tanzi is a Democratic state representative who has represented District 34 in the Rhode Island House of Representatives since 2011 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Tanzi attended the University of Rhode Island and Brown University.

Her professional experience includes working with local organizations including the Johnnycake Center Hunger Task Force, the Wakefield Downtown Merchants Association and Peace Dale Neighborhood Revitalization Inc., and she has also sat on the South Kingstown Economic Development Committee.
In the 2021-2022 legislative session Tanzi was assigned to the Innovation, Internet and Technology Committee and the State Government and Elections Committee.
